song.title: Stuck In The Middle With You

guitar.evidence: Stealers Wheel (Gerry Rafferty, Joe Egan) used various session musicians for guitar parts, including notably Hugh McCracken on the famous 'Stuck In The Middle With You' session; no documented personal signature instrument.
guitar.notes: Insufficient reliable documentation to assign a confident gear attribution; kept unknown.
